creative_brief: One main banner, three complementary body figures: concurrent plan price comparison, residential port explanation, custom high-bandwidth data delivery pipeline.

body_figures.name: 隧道代理按并发套餐
body_figures.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished standalone editorial product information image embedded in ONE long-form Chinese advertising article. Landscape 2:1 ratio, about 2048x1024 pixels. This is a BODY illustration, NOT a hero banner, NOT a set of alternative ads.
Audience: overseas web-scraping developers and AI engineers evaluating 123Proxy products.
Style: refined minimal enterprise information design, crisp modern Chinese sans-serif, dark navy headings, royal-blue accents, white and very pale cool gray canvas, readable large text and abundant spacing. Mostly actual product information, not decorative artwork. A tiny plain "123Proxy" wordmark in the top right is optional. No huge brand logo, no giant "不限流量海外爬虫代理" slogan, no call-to-action button, no URL, no QR code, no world map, no busy dashboards, no shiny 3D, no purple fan-art, no glowing sci-fi, no invented data.
Constraints: Render all specified Chinese text and prices VERBATIM; no extra factual claims or misleading promises. Never substitute QPS or 次/秒 for 并发线程. Never claim unlimited speed. Information hierarchy: product name -> who it serves -> product-specific explanation. No clipping or unreadably tiny footnotes. Create one image only. Each figure has its OWN content and layout, not the left-text/right-proxy-route template of a main banner.
Composition: a clean premium PRICING COMPARISON layout. Header along the top; three equally spaced, spacious plan columns beneath it, with bold blue discounted prices. No fake purchase-interface controls or crossed-out giant list prices. Below the price columns a single concise billing explanation and a subtle pair of small webpage/video outline symbols. Legible short bottom qualification.
Text (verbatim):
Title "隧道代理按并发"
Subtitle "网页爬虫 · 常规 YouTube 视频下载"
Column 1 "5 并发线程" and "¥270/月"
Column 2 "50 并发线程" and "¥2,700/月"
Column 3 "200 并发线程" and "¥9,000/月"
Small line under column 3 "折合 ¥45/线程/月"
Billing line "按同时在途请求配置容量 · 套餐内不限流量"
Footer "折后月价，最终以控制台为准"
Avoid any wording that implies a concurrency thread is one request per second. Do not add bandwidth promises.

Subtitle "面向 AI 大规模下载"
Capacity "10Gbps+"
Capacity qualification "单项目聚合带宽方案，需测试评估"
Pipeline stages in order: "公开数据源" -> "定制代理池" -> "爬虫集群" -> "客户存储"

Commercial line "不限流量 · 按项目报价"
Delivery line "技术支持独立交付"
Do not show any concurrency/thread counts, do not invent guaranteed single-connection speeds, no unsupported fixed price. Source-to-client data flow must be coherent.
